import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    
    # Normalize Category values: strip whitespace, convert to title case
    df['Category'] = df['Category'].str.strip().str.title()
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Group by Category and count orders
    counts = df.groupby('Category').size()
    return counts.to_dict()
